_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Represents the current Silver Cross Wave 3 single-to-double; Clek's row names the 2019 'Wave' (adapter SX5135-EU family). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Wave 3 (single-to-double; covers 2019 Wave)

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Wave — 2019 Wave and Coast car seat adapters (SX5135-EU)

specs._weightNote: Wave 3: 23.5 lb chassis + 5.8 lb main seat = ~29.3 lb single-seat config. Bassinet 8.5 lb, tandem seat 5.3 lb (add for double). The Clek-named 2019 Wave chassis was heavier (~24.2 lb chassis; ~30.8 lb w/ seat).
specs._dimsNote: Wave 3: open L43.72 x W23.5 x H37-43 in; folded L37.4 x W23.6 x H15.55 in (Silver Cross US).

brake.type: push-push pedal (foot) parking brake, flip-flop friendly

specs._brakeNote: Brake type from Strollberry Wave spec sheet: 'push-push pedal brake (flip-flop friendly)' — activated by pressing one side, released by pressing the other.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (bassinet + lie-flat seats included; ready as a double for newborn+toddler)

specs._basketNote: Basket rated 5 kg (~11 lb) per Strollberry Wave spec sheet.

safety.standards: ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 (US market). No specific standard is published on the Silver Cross US spec page; Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 in home market, not stated for US units). No named third-party certification (e.g. JPMA) published.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; lie-flat seats; puncture-proof multi-terrain tires with four-way independent suspension.

specs.recline: three positions incl. lie-flat (both main and tandem seats)
specs.tires: puncture-proof multi-terrain tires, four-way independent suspension

notes: Clek's row names the 2019 Wave (adapter SX5135-EU, shared with the Coast). The current US product is the Wave 3, which uses the same Wave/Coast car seat adapter family — represented here as the live, purchasable model ($1,699.99). Heavy full-size single-to-double (up to 3 kids) — opposite end of the spectrum from the light/compact city goal. Brake type not published (null).
